races.name: Navan Racing Festival 14th & 15th November Median Auction Maiden
races.verdict:
Having finished second in a barrier trial, CATUAI was far from disgraced pitched into listed company 2 weeks ago and down in class, he's the one to beat. This slight step up in distance will suit Better Yet so she's second choice, ahead of Marcescence.

  1. CATUAI
  2. BETTER YET (IRE)
  3. MARCESCENCE (IRE)

races.name: Buy Now & Save With The Real Deal Bundle Maiden
races.verdict:
MY CUBBY BEAR returned to form when second in a 6f handicap at Cork last week and may well be up to going one better back in maiden company, especially if the standard-setter Almeiyda underperforms once again. Lilli's Angel has a progressive profile which must count for something in an ordinary race, while Port Arthur is another who merits consideration.

  1. MY CUBBY BEAR (IRE)
  2. ALMEIYDA (IRE)
  3. LILLI'S ANGEL (IRE)

races.name: Navan Racing Festival Hospitality On Sale Now Nursery Handicap
races.verdict:
PRINCE OF PEPPARD improved at Fairyhouse 16 days ago and, with that form franked, looks capable of going one better from a 3 lb higher mark. Docks took a big step forward when second in a Naas nursery and rates the main danger despite a 5 lb rise, while Santo Parvenue won at Naas last month and continues in form despite his subsequent defeat at Down Royal.

  1. PRINCE OF PEPPARD (IRE)
  2. DOCKS (IRE)
  3. SANTO PARVENUE (IRE)

races.name: Book Your Discounted Tickets On NavanRacecourse.ie Handicap (0-60)
races.verdict:
THE LOVE MACHINE just failed to land a gamble here last month and can make amends off what remains a very workable mark. Pansy Poe fared much better on her second start for this yard at Cork last week so is next best ahead of Rosato, who has a good record here.

  1. THE LOVE MACHINE (IRE)
  2. PANSY POE (IRE)
  3. ROSATO (IRE)

races.name: Navan Racecourse Welcomes Our Local Community Maiden
races.verdict:
Probably an above-average maiden for the time of year and JESUS GREEN can get off the mark after a couple of fine efforts in defeat in a maiden and Group 1 at Leopardstown. Selosse shaped well in a red-hot Curragh maiden on debut and will improve, while Choctaw Nation is an appealing newcomer.

  1. JESUS GREEN (IRE)
  2. SELOSSE (IRE)
  3. CHOCTAW NATION (IRE)

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Fillies Handicap
races.verdict:
PINK OXALIS has been consistent without winning this year, but is now on a good mark and should go close if reproducing last month’s effort in a stronger handicap. Thrifty of Digby has eased slightly in the weights and tends to bounce back quickly from lesser efforts, so rates the main danger. Divine Legend opened her account in a Fairyhouse maiden recently and could be a fly in the ointment if improving now handicapping.

  1. PINK OXALIS (IRE)
  2. THRIFTY OF DIGBY (IRE)
  3. DIVINE LEGEND (IRE)

races.name: Racing Again 21st October Handicap (0-60) (Div 1)
races.verdict:
REPONSE FINALE has been a model of consistency since joining her current yard and, for all she can be slowly away, this track and trip should suit, so she gets the nod. Kodi Brown was second in this race last October from a 3 lb higher mark and rates the main danger if ready to go after an absence, while Connova and recent course runner-up Sheamus Seimhiu are also capable of being in the mix.

  1. REPONSE FINALE (IRE)
  2. KODI BROWN (IRE)
  3. CONNOVA (IRE)

races.name: Racing Again 21st October Handicap (0-60) (Div 2)
races.verdict:
PURE GRANITE is lightly raced for his age and made more impact when fourth at Punchestown on his return from 10 months off. Entitled to strip fitter, he can build on that and open his account. Pebble Island rates the main danger if reproducing the form of his Fairyhouse second in June, while Patrick Street and Charlie Brow'n are also respected.

  1. PURE GRANITE (IRE)
  2. PEBBLE ISLAND
  3. PATRICK STREET

races.name: Mowden Park RFC Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Bumper winner ARMS PARK can make a successful start in this sphere with doubts surrounding chief threats Military Cross and John Galt.

  1. ARMS PARK
  2. MILITARY CROSS (IRE)
  3. JOHN GALT (FR)

races.name: Fairlight Studios At Sedgefield Racecourse Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
A good opportunity for FLASHY BOY to get back on track back down in class. Henry Box Brown can follow him home.

  1. FLASHY BOY (IRE)
  2. HENRY BOX BROWN (IRE)
  3. SWINGFORTHEFENCE (IRE)

races.name: Jodie Standings Point-To-Point Recruits Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
JET OF DREAMS can confirm placings with Lady Kara with a competent claimer off-setting his penalty.

  1. JET OF DREAMS (IRE)
  2. LADY KARA
  3. NEIGH BOTHA (IRE)

races.name: Roxyfet Sports Lounge For Private Hire Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
AIMERIC and William Yeats have dominated a couple of course handicaps in recent weeks and they should come to the fore again, with the Candlish runner taken to make it 2-1 in their personal battle. Whatsgoingonmarvin should have a bigger performance in him over hurdles.

  1. AIMERIC
  2. WILLIAM YEATS
  3. WHATSGOINGONMARVIN (IRE)

races.name: Winning Connections Conference Hire Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
CHARACTER TESTING has finished behind Littletown Lad the last twice at this venue but he did shape quite a bit better than the result last time and from these better terms with a promising conditional rider booked, he can reverse the form now. American Empire is of some interest among those at longer odds.

  1. CHARACTER TESTING
  2. LITTLETOWN LAD (IRE)
  3. AMERICAN EMPIRE (IRE)

races.name: Sedgefield Racecourse For Outdoor Events Mares' Open NH Flat Race (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
CUMNOCK shaped encouragingly from an unpromising position when just failing to make a winning debut over C&D in late August and gets the nod to go one better. Youlooklikeyourmum was only 2 lengths behind the selection in the aforementioned race and should be capable of making her presence felt again, while Moyanna wouldn't need to improve much on her opening effort in the spring to have a big say in proceedings.

  1. CUMNOCK
  2. YOULOOKLIKEYOURMUM
  3. MOYANNA

races.name: Try Unibet's New Improved Acca Boosts Apprentice Handicap
races.verdict:
The return to all-weather with cheekpieces back on should see TIMELY AFFAIR quickly back on his game so he's awarded the vote to improve his already impressive strike rate for one of his ability. Stall 1 may not be ideal if Silver Trumpet blows the start again but he's a huge threat at this level, with Caragio also of interest.

  1. TIMELY AFFAIR
  2. SILVER TRUMPET
  3. CARAGIO (IRE)

races.name: Unibet Supports Safer Gambling EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
TWELVE BARS ran to a pretty high figure when runner-up starting out at Newmarket 2 weeks ago and expected to build on that, he looks the answer. There is plenty of depth to this novice though, with Lancaster Tower and debut winner Byzantine on the shortlist.

  1. TWELVE BARS (IRE)
  2. LANCASTER TOWER
  3. BYZANTINE (IRE)

races.name: Unibet Interactive Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
GODSPEED GIRL got loose on the way to post at Doncaster last time so she's worth another chance to build on her Newmarket debut. Usaylah and Tenshi look the pick of the newcomers.

  1. GODSPEED GIRL (GER)
  2. USAYLAH (FR)
  3. TENSHI (IRE)

races.name: Unibet More Extra Place Races Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
ALPINARA looked a useful prospect when beating a couple of subsequent winners at Doncaster back in June so she looks the one to beat under a penalty. Yamnah was a big eyecatcher first-time out at Windsor and can offer most resistance.

  1. ALPINARA
  2. YAMNAH (FR)
  3. QUEEN OF SCOTLAND

races.name: Try Unibet's New Smartview Racecards Handicap
races.verdict:
Not as competitive as the numbers suggest and ROYAL COUNTY GLORY is well worth forgiving a lesser effort on turf at Brighton and taken to bounce back in style returned to polytrack with Oisin Murphy in the saddle. Seeing Stars also goes well here and this C&D winner rates the chief threat ahead of Cixi and Upsomdowns.

  1. ROYAL COUNTY GLORY (IRE)
  2. SEEING STARS
  3. CIXI (USA)

races.name: Get Daily Price Boosts At Unibet Handicap
races.verdict:
An open sprint in which it could pay to side with KINIRO to bounce back in style off a lenient-looking mark now Oisin Murphy is back in the saddle. Madman is progressing well and rates a big threat though, while polytrack debutants Charlie Boyo and Blue Orbit command respect too.

  1. KINIRO
  2. MADMAN
  3. CHARLIE BOYO (IRE)

races.name: Set Your Limits With Unibet Handicap
races.verdict:
A few with chances but this could go the way of C&D scorer NOW THE EAGLE who wasn't seen to ideal effect when fourth at Newmarket last time and returns here on a lenient-looking mark. Hat-trick seeking Last Flight rates a big threat, while Luan is also well in the mix on the back of a facile Wolverhampton success.

  1. NOW THE EAGLE (FR)
  2. LAST FLIGHT
  3. LUAN (FR)

races.name: Unibet 3 Uniboosts A Day Handicap
races.verdict:
VIOLET GOLDSMITH rates the pick of the weights and with this return to 1m a positive she is fancied to resume winning ways. Mbappe hasn't been at his best this summer but Billy Loughnane takes the ride for the first time since his C&D success in the winter so merits consideration, especially if the market vibes are positive. Hat-trick seeking Snooker McCrew can also have a say.

  1. VIOLET GOLDSMITH
  2. MBAPPE
  3. SNOOKER MCCREW

races.name: CopyBet Follow Us On X Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
KING ROLY is back at the top of his game and went like the best horse at the weights when denied by a stablemate at Cartmel. He can land a second C&D success. Snipe has to be the danger after his near-miss at Warwick.

  1. KING ROLY
  2. SNIPE (IRE)
  3. AWAYTHELAD (IRE)

races.name: CopyBet For Premier League Profit Boosts Novices' Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
KELIJOE would have made an impressive start over fences at Uttoxeter in March had he stood up (unseated 2 out when almost 20 lengths clear) and looks sure to win races in this sphere on that showing. This represents a classier field but he can make amends if ready to go. All 5 of his rivals could make their mark over fences, with Draco Malfoy perhaps the most interesting on his return.

  1. KELIJOE (FR)
  2. DRACO MALFOY (IRE)
  3. IN THE AGE (FR)

races.name: Step Into Luxury With Purple Granite NH Flat Race (Conditionals/Amateurs) (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
CRYSTALATE looked unlucky not to win at Southwell in May having been repeatedly hampered, so she's taken to gain compensation. Dundee Law has transferred to the Skeltons and could well have more to offer in the bumper sphere, while Royalty Row'd and winning pointer Lower De Couely are others to consider.

  1. CRYSTALATE (IRE)
  2. DUNDEE LAW
  3. ROYALTY ROW'D (IRE)

races.name: CopyBet Supporting UK Horse Racing Fillies' Juvenile Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
The betting will prove informative with the majority of these fillies having their first outing over obstacles, EARTH MAID selected to make a winning start for the powerful Skelton yard. We're Out of Aces showed promise amidst greenness first time up so she can feature with improvement likely. The selection's stablemate Miss Moffett and stable-switcher Song of The Stars complete the shortlist.

  1. EARTH MAID
  2. WE'RE OUT OF ACES (IRE)
  3. MISS MOFFETT

races.name: FBC Manby Bowdler Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race) (Div 1)
races.verdict:
Having faced a stiff task on hurdling debut, LEXINGTON WOOD made a much bigger impact when finishing runner-up in a Perth maiden in May and fitted in a first-time hood for his return, Olly Murphy's 5-y-o can make it third time lucky. Yeld To Call went very close at Newton Abbot last month, so she heads up the dangers, while Dan Skelton saddles 3 and his German import Northern Olympian looks the most interesting on paper.

  1. LEXINGTON WOOD (FR)
  2. YELD TO CALL (FR)
  3. NORTHERN OLYMPIAN (GER)

races.name: FBC Manby Bowdler Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race) (Div 2)
races.verdict:
Dan Skelton and Olly Murphy saddle 8 of the 13 runners with SHEEZER DANCER the obvious port of call on her return to action. Taranis Dubh should have more to offer this season, while point recruit King's Affinity demands respect.

  1. SHEEZER DANCER (FR)
  2. TARANIS DUBH
  3. KING'S AFFINITY

races.name: PJ Nicholls KGM Korea Genuinely Made Novices' Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
Cases can be made for several and at the likely prices it could pay to take a chance on THESOLDIERSMINIT, who upped his game when a close third on handicap debut in February and Sam Allwood's 5-y-o has been off since producing a lesser effort the following month. Jollie Dame looks an obvious danger for top connections now handicapping, with Calibos and I Heard A Rumour another couple worth mentioning, too.

  1. THESOLDIERSMINIT (IRE)
  2. JOLLIE DAME
  3. CALIBOS

races.name: CopyBet Overnight Best Odds Guaranteed Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
BROOKSIDE LA shaped very well considering the severity of a mistake around halfway when third at Haydock back in early-April so, provided he's ready to roll, Dan Skelton's 6-y-o can make amends despite a further 4 lb nudge. Heading up the opposition is Not At That Price, who ran his best race in maidens last time and may have more to offer now handicapping on return. Fighting Falcon and Constantinian can fight out minor honours.

  1. BROOKSIDE LA (IRE)
  2. NOT AT THAT PRICE
  3. FIGHTING FALCON (IRE)

races.name: EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Clive Cox has brought his juveniles on appreciably for a run this season so CASTLEROCK GIRL is fancied to go one better after her encouraging debut at Southwell 2 weeks ago. Form pick Californian Angel remains with potential so is the obvious threat.

  1. CASTLEROCK GIRL (IRE)
  2. CALIFORNIAN ANGEL
  3. SPELL CATCHER

races.name: Racedays For 9 Pound At Nottingham Racecourse Fillies' Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
NOWSHESDANCING is likely to be suited by this step up in trip so she gets the vote in a tight-looking handicap. Reem Rak is next best back on better ground, with handicap newcomer Palomezcal completing the shortlist.

  1. NOWSHESDANCING
  2. REEM RAK (IRE)
  3. PALOMEZCAL

races.name: British EBF Future Stayers Oath Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
In receipt of her 5 lb sex allowance and following on from a promising debut at Newmarket, GAINFUL should take some stopping. That said, Top Scholar and Prince Of Petra are both bred to be well above average so need close attention in the market.

  1. GAINFUL
  2. TOP SCHOLAR
  3. PRINCE OF PETRA (IRE)

races.name: British Stallion Studs EBF Nursery (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
Both AKARAKA and Northern Viola promise to be well served by this further step up in distance, with marginal preference for the former given his runner-up effort at Thirsk appeals as pretty strong form for the grade.

  1. AKARAKA
  2. NORTHERN VIOLA
  3. KANZI

races.name: Jeremy Bradbeer Memorial Handicap
races.verdict:
DUKE'S COMMAND looked back in form at Southwell 2 weeks ago and is capable of scoring for the first time in 2026 from this reduced mark. 3-y-os Tamzan and Quisana both arrive on the back of positive placed efforts and also make appeal.

  1. DUKE'S COMMAND
  2. TAMZAN
  3. QUISANA (IRE)

races.name: Watch Racing TV Now Handicap (GBBPlus Race) (Div 1)
races.verdict:
GET OUTTA HERE finished at Windsor in the manner of one who should benefit from this step up in trip and David Menuisier's gelding is fancied to score for the second time. Recent Wolverhampton winner Norman Invasion is still unexposed and can pose the biggest threat ahead of Medway Queen.

  1. GET OUTTA HERE (FR)
  2. NORMAN INVASION
  3. MEDWAY QUEEN (IRE)

races.name: Watch Racing TV Now Handicap (GBBPlus Race) (Div 2)
races.verdict:
A competitive handicap, with SIGLIOSA, who travelled as if ahead of his rating at Chester last time, chanced to get off the mark faced with these quicker conditions. Kokoluna is respected after being awarded a race at Goodwood last month, whilst Edwin Hubble also merits consideration.

  1. SIGLIOSA
  2. KOKOLUNA
  3. EDWIN HUBBLE (IRE)

races.name: Construction Day 14th October Apprentice Handicap
races.verdict:
KING CHERRY seemed well suited by the switch to front-running tactics over this sprint trip when winning at Kempton last week and can follow up under a penalty. Asadjumeirah looks the main danger on recent form, though it's been a while since he's tackled turf, with Golden Prosperity taken to round out the 1-2-3.

  1. KING CHERRY (IRE)
  2. ASADJUMEIRAH
  3. GOLDEN PROSPERITY (IRE)

Prix De L'ile De Tiboulen Handicap
Prix Du Cercle Des Phoceens Claiming Stakes
Prix Du Port De L'eoube Stakes
Prix Du Grand Vivier Maiden Stakes

Prix De L'hotel De Vermandois Handicap
Prix De La Tour Montparnasse - Attele
